title: Move a story without breaking its identity or links
preconditions: A story has current relations and can move between existing feature homes.

steps.action: Move the story to another feature with the supported mutation.
steps.expected_result: The story keeps the same canonical URN while its storage home changes.

steps.action: Reload the Saga and evaluate every existing relation to the story and its criteria.
steps.expected_result: All links remain current without replacement identities or manual rewrites.

expected_result: Pass when moving the story preserves identity and current relations; fail if the move changes its URN, loses history, or stales valid links.
